rule.title: A dividend on stock held less than 61 days of the 121-day period is not a qualified dividend

when_missing.because: Dividends the payer reports as qualified are qualified unless a preparer says the holding period was not met

citation.wording: Dividends you received on any share of stock that you held for less than 61 days during the 121-day period that began 60 days before the ex-dividend date.

rule.open_point: Box 1a (line 3b) is unchanged: the dividend stays ordinary. When only some lots fail the test the disqualified part is an amount the form does not print; only an answer covering the whole box is applied.
